Precise next data/construction: (1) owned intraday/overnight OHLC to test open-to-close gap reversal with explicit execution modeling; or (2) a lower-turnover fast family driven by PIT event data (earnings-timing / filing drift), which requires a paid PIT entitlement not currently owned.
